result_revision.change_summary: Correct training-compute provenance using the submitter-reported matching run: 2.03 hours wall time and estimated 8.12 GPU-hours assuming four GPUs. Predictions, metrics, checkpoints and inference timing are inherited unchanged from v1.

methodology.record_note: Released CarBench Transolver checkpoint used for the unchanged v1 predictions. Metadata-only revision: training wall time corrected to the 2.03 hours reported by Mohamed Elrefaie in PR #66 for Transolver_results_20251027_203801 (best epoch 191, batch 128). Aggregate GPU-hours remain estimated because the DataParallel device count was not recorded. No training, inference or metric recomputation was performed for this revision.

architecture.description: Transolver physics-attention transformer: 5 blocks, 256 hidden width, 8 heads, 32 physics slices, MLP ratio 2, predicting surface pressure from per-point coordinates and outward normals.

components.description: Five physics-attention blocks over 32 learned slices with a per-point pressure head.

key_hyperparameters.name: points_per_forward_pass
key_hyperparameters.description: Surface points per forward pass in training and inference.

input_features.name: surface_coordinates
input_features.description: Native surface-point x/y/z in metres, normalized with training-set statistics.

input_features.name: surface_normals
input_features.description: Consistently auto-oriented VTK point normals of the native surface.

predicted_fields.description: Kinematic gauge pressure (m^2/s^2) at every native surface point, denormalized with training-set mean and standard deviation.

data_handling.normalization: Pressure standardized with training-split mean -94.5 and standard deviation 117.25 m^2/s^2; coordinates normalized with training-split statistics.
data_handling.preprocessing: Per-point outward normals from VTK compute_normals with consistency and auto-orientation on the native surface; no remeshing.
data_handling.sampling: Training: one fixed seeded 10,000-point subsample per design. Inference: ceil(N/10000) disjoint seeded random passes cover every native point once; the final pass is padded with already-predicted points for context and only new points are kept.

stages.description: Supervised training on the official DrivAerNet++ training split with model selection on the official validation split.

loss.description: Mean-squared error on standardized pressure at the sampled surface points.

optimizers.name: Adam
optimizers.schedule: StepLR: multiply by 0.1 every 150 epochs; gradient clipping at 1.0.

duration.description: 191 recorded epochs; the released checkpoint is the lowest validation-loss epoch (191).

compute.measurement_notes: Submitter-reported correction in https://github.com/neilashton/fluidsbench-submission/pull/66: the matching recorded run Transolver_results_20251027_203801 (best epoch 191, batch 128) has 2.03 hours training wall time. The visible DataParallel device count was not recorded; four A100-SXM4-80GB GPUs are assumed, giving an estimated 8.12 GPU-hours. measurement_basis remains estimated for the aggregate device cost. The underlying training logs were not independently replayed or remeasured by the maintainer.

checkpoints.bytes_description: Raw bytes of transolver.pth from the CarBench v1.0 weights release, loaded unchanged.
checkpoints.role: Exact loaded checkpoint for every prediction.
checkpoints.selection_rule: Lowest official-validation loss, selected before any test-case inference.

inference_compute.hardware: 1 x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB shared by two inference processes
inference_compute.measurement_notes: Wall time from first to last prediction file, two concurrent processes on one A100 that other training jobs were also using (per-case times summed to 3,876 s across the two processes). Includes VTK reading, normal computation, all patch passes and prediction serialization; excludes model loading and the FluidsBench evaluator.

note: Metadata-only dev revision of Transolver v1 correcting training-compute provenance. Original predictions, metric values, checkpoint and legacy inference timing are reused; the evaluation command and evaluation timestamps record the original v1 run. Not owner-approved and not an official result.

evaluation.command: python scripts/drivaernetplusplus.py evaluate-entry my-entry --output work/transolver --resume && python scripts/drivaernetplusplus.py package --evaluation-root work/transolver/evaluation --config package-config.json --discretization-cases discretization-cases.jsonl --checkpoint carbench-transolver=transolver.pth --output submissions/drivaernetplusplus/drivaernetplusplus-carbench-transolver-dev-v1
